instruction: Pull over beside the closest dark car on the right.
paraphrases: Stop next to the nearby dark car on the right.|Park beside the prominent right-hand dark car.

instruction: Stop near the white van on the right.
paraphrases: Pull over next to the right-hand white van.|Park beside the white van ahead on the right.

instruction: Pass the dark medium vehicle ahead on the left, then stop near the white van on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the dark left-hand medium vehicle and stop by the white van on the right.|After the medium vehicle on the left, pull over near the white van.

instruction: Pass the dark car on the left, then stop near the bus ahead on the left.
paraphrases: Go past the dark left-hand car and stop by the bus ahead.|After the dark car on the left, pull over near the bus.
What car is in front of us?|Identify the car directly ahead.

instruction: Stop beside the pedestrian next to the dark car ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Pull over by the pedestrian near the right-hand dark car.|Park next to the pedestrian beside the dark car ahead.

instruction: Pass the partially visible car at the far-left edge, then stop near the dark car ahead on the left.
paraphrases: Go past the cut-off car on the left and stop by the dark car ahead.|After the partly visible left-edge car, pull over near the dark car in front.

instruction: Stop beside the motorbike on the left—correction, stop near the car ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Take the motorbike on the left—rather, the car ahead on the right.|Stop near the car on the right, not the motorbike on the left.

instruction: Stop beside the closer dark sedan on the right, not the medium vehicle farther left.
paraphrases: Take the nearby dark sedan on the right, not the medium vehicle on the left.|Pull over by the closer dark sedan rather than the left medium vehicle.

instruction: Pull over beside the white car on the right near the overpass.
paraphrases: Stop next to the right-hand white car by the overpass.|Park beside the white car on the right.
